summary: ios/ is a zero-third-party-dependency SwiftUI companion app generated by XcodeGen from ios/project.yml (Garrison.xcodeproj is gitignored): three targets - GarrisonApp (application, com.gomes.garrison, iOS 17.0), BroadcastExtension (ReplayKit upload extension, com.gomes.garrison.broadcast) and GarrisonTests (unit bundle; the only SPM dependency, Nordic CoreBluetoothMock, hangs off this target). ios/Shared/ is compiled as sources into both shipping targets, not a framework. The App Group group.com.gomes.garrison UserDefaults suite is the ONLY channel between app and extension and is the whole "node" store today: capture.baseURL (the CAPTURE-SERVICE URL, e.g. https://host.ts.net:8497, not the shell origin), capture.token (CAPTURE_TOKEN, Bearer), capture.deviceName, consent + speak.* + pendant.* + broadcast.heartbeat/lastError keys. CaptureUploader (Shared) opens wss://<baseURL host>/capture/stream with Authorization: Bearer <token>, sends a JSON session_start {session_id, mode audio|screen_audio|pendant, device_name, consent, started_at, codec}, then binary [kind u8][seq u32][ts f64][len u32] frames, spool-then-send with resume from the server's acked high-water; the server (capture-service/lib/ingress.mjs) answers 404/403/401 on the raw socket before the upgrade. Three session producers exist: CaptureController (audio via AVAudioEngine + OpusEncoder, .playAndRecord/.voiceChat/.defaultToSpeaker for AEC), SampleHandler in the extension (screen_audio: 1.5 fps 720px JPEG + Opus mic, started by the user tapping RPSystemBroadcastPickerView), and PendantController (pendant: CoreBluetooth transport -> uploader, haptic feedback back, /health flag read). Voice-out is SpeechSink: plays the server's pre-rendered clip at ack.audioPath resolved relative to capture.baseURL via ClipPlayer/AVAudioPlayer, else falls back to on-device AVSpeechSynthesizer with pt-PT/en voice pick, and sends a spoken receipt; every ack lands in AckLog (App Group JSONL). PushManager registers APNs (UNUserNotificationCenter + registerForRemoteNotifications; entitlement aps-environment production + time-sensitive) and POSTs {apns_token, device_name} to /capture/devices; a notification tap only appends to AckLog - there is no deep link, URL type, associated domain or onOpenURL anywhere. Info.plist declares UIBackgroundModes [bluetooth-central] only (no audio, no remote-notification) and NSAllowsArbitraryLoads. Entry point is a @main SwiftUI App with a UIApplicationDelegateAdaptor for APNs callbacks and pendant auto-connect on launch/foreground; screens are ContentView (start audio / broadcast picker / nav), ConversationView (polls GET /capture/exchanges every 5 s), SessionsView (GET /capture/sessions + AckLogView), SettingsView (@AppStorage over the App Group + Test connection + Register for push), PendantView (connect/disconnect, battery, haptic support, SSE transcript from /sessions/<id>/events), ConsentSheet. Nine XCTest files; one (PendantFeedbackMappingTests.testPendantIsOwnedByTheAppNotByAView) is a source-text check that reads PendantView.swift and GarrisonApp.swift from disk. Signing is manual (Apple Distribution, match AppStore profiles, DEVELOPMENT_TEAM from APPLE_TEAM_ID); fastlane beta (xcodegen generate -> match -> build_app -> upload_to_testflight) is wrapped by scripts/ios-testflight.sh / npm run ios:testflight. On THIS Mac xcodegen 2.45.4 is installed but Xcode.app is absent (CommandLineTools only), fastlane is not installed and there is no Gemfile.lock, so xcodegen generate works but xcodebuild test / fastlane cannot run here; the pendant report shows the simulator suite was run on the Mac mini (Xcode 26.2) and TestFlight builds came from the hosted ios-thing CI lane. Capacitor: nothing in package.json or node_modules; @capacitor/ios (7.6.9 and 8.5.1) ships only podspecs, SPM support comes from the separate github.com/ionic-team/capacitor-swift-pm package that the CLI references from a generated CapApp-SPM/Package.swift, and the CLI hardcodes the <ios.path>/App/App + App.xcodeproj layout, so shape A means referencing capacitor-swift-pm directly from project.yml packages:, hand-maintaining capacitor.config.json as an app-bundle resource, registering in-app CAPPlugin subclasses from a CAPBridgeViewController subclass (capacitorDidLoad -> registerPluginInstance), and never running npx cap sync against this tree.

facts.fact: Three XcodeGen targets: GarrisonApp (application, com.gomes.garrison, sources GarrisonApp + GarrisonApp/Resources + Shared), BroadcastExtension (app-extension, com.gomes.garrison.broadcast, sources BroadcastExtension + Shared), GarrisonTests (bundle.unit-test, com.gomes.garrison.tests, sources Tests + GarrisonApp/Pendant/PendantBLETransport.swift recompiled). Shared/ is compiled into both shipping targets as sources, no framework.
Deployment target iOS 17.0; bundleIdPrefix com.gomes; MARKETING_VERSION 1.0; TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY 1,2; GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE NO with explicit Info.plist and entitlements files per target.

Manual signing: DEVELOPMENT_TEAM "${APPLE_TEAM_ID}", CODE_SIGN_STYLE Manual, CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY "Apple Distribution" repeated with the sdk-qualified key CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY[sdk=iphoneos*] at project AND target level; PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER "match AppStore com.gomes.garrison" / "match AppStore com.gomes.garrison.broadcast"; test target uses Automatic signing with empty identity. ADR §1 says these two rules (sdk-qualified override, repetition at target level) are load-bearing against xcodegen's preset injecting iPhone Developer.

App Group identifier is group.com.gomes.garrison; AppGroup.defaults = UserDefaults(suiteName:) is injectable for tests. Entitlements: app has application-groups + aps-environment production + com.apple.developer.usernotifications.time-sensitive; extension has application-groups only. No associated-domains entitlement.

Node identity today is two App Group keys: capture.baseURL (comment: e.g. https://host.ts.net:8498 - the CAPTURE-SERVICE base URL, not the shell origin) and capture.token (CAPTURE_TOKEN). Plus capture.deviceName (default "iPhone"), capture.consentSuppressed, speak.master/info/rate/volume/voiceId/quietStart/quietEnd/muteUntil/cues, pendant.identifier (CBPeripheral UUID string), pendant.ambientConsent, broadcast.heartbeat/lastError/lastErrorAt. Accessors AppGroup.baseURL: URL? and AppGroup.token: String? trim whitespace and return nil when empty. Only one node can be stored; there is no list.

AppGroup.request(path:method:body:) builds every authenticated HTTP call: URLComponents(base).path = path, Authorization: Bearer <token>, application/json when a body exists, 15 s timeout. Used by PushManager (POST /capture/devices), ConversationView (GET /capture/exchanges), SessionsView + SettingsView (GET /capture/sessions).

CaptureUploader.socketURL rewrites the base URL scheme https->wss / http->ws and sets path /capture/stream; openTask puts Authorization: Bearer <token> on the URLRequest and uses URLSession.webSocketTask(with:) (waitsForConnectivity true, timeoutIntervalForRequest 10). On didOpen it sends SessionStartMessage {type:"session_start", session_id, mode, device_name, consent, started_at ISO8601, codec?}. Media is sent only when state == .streaming && serverConfirmedStart; frames are spooled first (SessionSpool 48 MB two-segment ring in the App Group container) and drained after session_started / session_resumed(audio_seq, video_seq); reconnect backoff 1->16 s.

Server side confirms the contract: handleUpgrade on the http server's upgrade event answers 404 for any path other than /capture/stream, 403 when disabled or no captureToken secret, 401 when the Bearer header does not match, then wss.handleUpgrade; binary frames before session_start close with 1008.

SessionMode enum: audio = "audio", screenAudio = "screen_audio", pendant = "pendant". Producers: CaptureController -> .audio; BroadcastExtension SampleHandler -> .screenAudio; PendantController -> .pendant with deviceName "<deviceName> pendant" and codec "opus"/"opus_fs320". ConsentState shown/suppressed rides session_start.

Binary framing: [kind u8 (audio=0, video=1)][seq u32 LE][ts f64 LE][len u32 LE][payload], headerLength 17. Control JSON client->server: session_start, session_end {reason}, spoken {spoken, ok, reason} receipt, feedback_ack {event_id}. Server->client parsed by ServerMessage.parse: session_started, session_resumed, ack {stream, seq}, session_ended, speak {ack: AckPayload{id, kind, severity, templateId, text, cardId, idempotencyKey, emittedAt, audioPath, lang}}, feedback {event: FeedbackEvent{event_id, name, session_id, at, reason, card_id, title, interim, speak{text, lang, audio_path, priority}}}, error. SessionId.generate gives 22-char [A-Za-z0-9_-] ids.

@MainActor ObservableObject; Phase idle/connecting/live/interrupted/failed; @Published phase, sessionId, startedAt, ackedFrames. start(consent:) fails with "Set the base URL and token in Settings first." when AppGroup.baseURL/token are nil, checks AVAudioApplication.shared.recordPermission, creates CaptureUploader mode .audio, wires onAck/onStateChange and onSpeak -> speechSink.handle + AckLog. Audio session: .playAndRecord, mode .voiceChat, options [.defaultToSpeaker, .allowBluetoothHFP] (hardware AEC per ADR §6); tap bufferSize 4096 -> OpusEncoder (16 kHz mono 32 kbps VBR, scene AGC). stop() flushes encoder, speechSink.stopAll, uploader.end, 3 s grace. Observes AVAudioSession interruption / configuration change / mediaServicesWereReset.

BroadcastPicker is a UIViewRepresentable RPSystemBroadcastPickerView (60x60) with preferredExtension "com.gomes.garrison.broadcast" and showsMicrophoneButton true. A broadcast starts only from the user's tap on that system picker; the app cannot start it programmatically. SampleHandler.broadcastStarted refuses (noteBroadcastError + finishBroadcastWithError) when AppGroup.baseURL/token are missing, builds CaptureUploader mode .screenAudio with consent from consentSuppressed, stamps AppGroup.noteBroadcastAlive per frame; 1.5 fps, longest side 720, JPEG q0.5, mic -> Opus, app audio ignored. Liveness is a heartbeat (stale after 8 s) read by the app via AppGroup.isBroadcasting; ContentView polls it every 2 s.

SpeechSink(utterer: Utterer = SpeechUtterer(AVSpeechSynthesizer), clipPlayer: ClipPlaying? = ClipPlayer()) reads speak.* controls live from the App Group; queueCeiling 3, stalenessSeconds 30, cueStalenessSeconds 2.5. handle(AckPayload) drops with receipt reasons sink-off/muted/info-muted/stale/queue-overflow; pump plays the server clip when ack.audioPath is non-empty (receipt reason "clip"), else synthesises locally ("synth:<lang>" / "synth-default:...") choosing pt -> [pt-PT], en -> [en-GB, en-US]. speakCue(Cue) handles feedback speak cues (audioPath or text). ClipPlayer resolves URL(string: path, relativeTo: AppGroup.baseURL) - i.e. /speak/<hash>.mp3 on the capture-service origin - with returnCacheDataElseLoad, 8 s timeout, AVAudioPlayer(data:); SpeechAudioSession.activateIfNeeded uses .playback/.spokenAudio/.duckOthers unless the session is already .playAndRecord.
